Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: This site is a free fan-made tracker. You can use it without an account: logging in with Discord is optional.
Privacy.analytics: Cloudflare Web Analytics counts page views without cookies and without identifying you: it sees the page, the country and the browser type in aggregate.
Privacy.hosting: The site and its data API run on Cloudflare. Like any web host, Cloudflare processes your IP address to deliver the page and protect it from attacks.
Privacy.settings: Your language and filters live in the page address, not on our side.
Privacy.not: No emails, passwords, Epic accounts or payment data. We do not sell or share data, and there is no advertising tracking.
Privacy.links: Links to Discord and other sites follow those sites' own privacy policies.
Privacy.contact: Questions about privacy: write to us on Discord.
Privacy.account: If you log in with Discord, we store your Discord user id, name, avatar and language, plus a login cookie (stw_session) for 30 days, and the notification filters you create. Logging out ends the session. To delete your data, write to us on Discord.

DailyQuests.title: Daily Quests
DailyQuests.metaDescription: Every Fortnite Save the World daily quest with its V-Bucks reward, screenshots of what to look for and tips on where to do it fastest.
DailyQuests.intro:
After the tutorial you get a new daily quest every day and can hold up to 3 at a time.
Once a day you can replace one of them with a random new quest.
Every quest counts on any difficulty.
DailyQuests.categoryNotes: For every quest in this category

Questline.title: Questline
Questline.metaDescription: Every Save the World main quest in all four zones: what to do, every reward, and how many quests are left until the next V-Bucks.
Questline.intro:
Main quests of all four zones, in the order the game gives them.
Each zone has 6 Storm Shield Defenses that pay {amount} V-Bucks each: {total} V-Bucks for the whole questline.
Storm Shield Defenses 7–10 are side quests.

SideQuests.title: Side Quests
SideQuests.metaDescription: Every Save the World side quest and challenge with its rewards. The ones that pay V-Bucks are listed first: Storm Shield Defenses 7–10, Mission Accomplished!, Hold the Door!, Toxic Treasures.
SideQuests.intro:
All side quests and repeatable challenges with their rewards.
The ones that pay V-Bucks are collected in the list below and marked in gold.
SideQuests.challengesNote: Each challenge has 20 stages; every next stage asks for a bit more.

Faq.title: FAQ
Faq.metaDescription: How many V-Bucks you can earn in Fortnite Save the World and where they come from: daily quests, mission alerts, the questline, side quests and challenges.
Faq.qHowMuch: How many V-Bucks can you earn in Save the World, and where?
Faq.aHowMuch:
Daily quests and mission alerts pay every day; everything else pays once.
Where the amount changes, the table shows the smallest one with a plus.
Faq.dailyHow: A new quest every day, up to 3 at a time; 100 or 150 each
Faq.alertsHow: Every day after the 00:00 UTC rotation
Faq.questlineHow: Once: Storm Shield Defenses 1–6 in each of the 4 zones
Faq.challengesHow: Once: Mission Accomplished!, Hold the Door! and Toxic Treasures, 20 stages × 50
Faq.lok: Lok’s Book of Monsters: Floating Freaks
Faq.eventsHow: Event questlines have not paid V-Bucks since Road Trip in 2018
Faq.once: Once, in total: {amount} V-Bucks, plus daily quests and missions every day.
Faq.aWho:
Only Founders: players who bought a Founder’s Pack, which was sold until mid-2020.
Everyone else gets the same amount of X-Ray Tickets instead of V-Bucks from all these sources.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.metaDescription: Get a Discord DM from Fishstick when today's Save the World missions match your filters.
Notifications.intro: After each rotation (00:00 UTC) Fishstick checks the missions and sends you a Discord DM when they match a subscription. One message per subscription per day.
Notifications.demo: Notifications need the live data API, so they are off in demo mode.
Notifications.loginText: Subscriptions belong to your Discord account: Fishstick sends them as DMs.
Notifications.empty: No subscriptions yet: create one below.
Notifications.filtersHint: Filters work like in the tracker. Without an item or filters you get every alert of the day.
Notifications.cannotDm: Discord does not let Fishstick DM you. Join a server with Fishstick or add it to your apps, then try again.
Notifications.tooSoon: One test a minute: try again shortly.
Notifications.limit: You have the maximum number of subscriptions. Delete one first.
Notifications.error: Something went wrong. Try again later.
Notifications.dmTitle: Make sure the DMs reach you
Notifications.dmText: Discord delivers bot DMs only if you share a server with Fishstick or added it to your apps.
Notifications.serverNote: Alerts in a server channel: run /setup alerts in Discord (needs Manage Server).
